primarySource.title: Serum Concentrations of Inhibin B in Healthy Females and Males Throughout Life

supplement.contents: Validation, method comparison, storage, interference, quality control; Figures S1–S3. No female median table or LMS/GAMLSS parameters.

cohorts.name: Health2006
cohorts.sampling: Adults from Western Copenhagen randomly selected from Danish National Personal Registry

adultLimitations: Only 149 women across 20–69 years; adult observations sparse.
Sampling was not standardized to menstrual-cycle phase.
Oral contraceptive information missing for the majority of women.
Reference data were not a confirmed untreated-only population.
No pregnancy-specific eligibility or pregnancy median model is described.
The age model does not establish individual menopause or reproductive state.

assay.allFemaleSamples: Beckman Coulter Inhibin B Gen II ELISA
assay.sourceBelowLodHandling: LOD/2 for source fitting; do not impute patient results or manufacture a numeric postmenopausal point.
assay.supplementMethodComparison: Oxford Bio-innovation measured higher than Gen II, overall ratio 1.28. Authors did not factorize Gen II results. This is not permission to convert unknown patient methods.
compatibilityRecommendation: known Gen II method IDs compatible
known Oxford or plasma should not newly become compatible for this female profile
unknown method/specimen may remain educational comparison with method limits, never evidence of confirmed compatibility

medianEvidence.statistic: GAMLSS 0 SD = M, median in equation SDS=((X/M)^L−1)/(L*S)
medianEvidence.toleranceMeaning: Approximate graphical extraction uncertainty, not a statistical confidence interval.
medianEvidence.upperBoundaryReason: 47 is the last retained, previously verified quantitative digitization knot, not maximum observed age. Do not extend to 69 using a qualitative low tail.
medianEvidence.lowerBoundaryReason: The existing 5.6–20 range is extended within the same source; no artificial new source boundary at 20. Compare-sexes window 8–20 remains separate.

lastKnotAboveLod.conclusion: 11 and its approximate digitization range 9–13 are above LOD 3. This supports a source-number at 47, not postmenopausal classification or extrapolation past 47.

notes: Adolescent oral-contraceptive effect is demonstrated; no phase-specific or treated-age median model is supplied.

13% of reproductive-age women 15–50 had undetectable concentrations; late-luteal nadir and oral contraception are possible explanations, so a single low value does not establish reduced ovarian function.
Do not correct patient concentrations for oral contraception or offer an invented untreated median.
Unknown cycle/OC status may remain an explicitly limited age comparison, preserving minimal input UX.

appPolicyRecommendation.knownPregnancy: Exclude the single ordinary 5.6–47 profile when pregnancy is already known. This is conservative app policy, not an author-reported cohort exclusion.
appPolicyRecommendation.knownPostmenopause: Exclude the single ordinary 5.6–47 profile when menopause is already known; no menopausal-state median model is supplied.
appPolicyRecommendation.ordinaryCyclePhases: Do not pick phase-specific median or require phase. Any existing ordinary phase remains same descriptive age model with limitation.
appPolicyRecommendation.missingReproductiveContext: Do not assume confirmed nonpregnant or premenopausal state.

cycleAndMedication.suggestedCompactPatientNote: Przybliżona mediana dla wieku; model nie uwzględnia fazy cyklu ani antykoncepcji.

qualification.reproductiveExclusionMeaning: Conservative application policy for this ordinary profile, not an author-reported cohort exclusion criterion; source has no pregnancy-specific or menopausal-state median model.
qualification.missingContext: Allows explicitly limited age comparison; never confirms nonpregnant, premenopausal, untreated status or matching assay.
qualification.patientNote: Cykl i antykoncepcja mogą wpływać na porównanie.

crofton2002.title: Dimeric inhibins in girls from birth to adulthood: relationship with age, pubertal stage, FSH and oestradiol
crofton2002.assay: Historical in-house double-antibody ELISA (Groome 1996), with heat/detergent/peroxide pretreatment; not Beckman Gen II.
crofton2002.applicability: Potential future historical whole-group reference for gap >1–<5.6 only, with explicit age 0–6 group label. It is not exact-age p50 and cannot describe minipuberty shape. N=105 is not tiny, but broad pooling, substantial censoring, different matrix/assay and convenience sampling are important limitations.
crofton2002.tannerCaution: Separate staged cohort includes GH-treated girls at B1/B3–5, with B2 treated girls excluded; do not describe all Tanner data as untreated healthy girls.
crofton2002.decision: Do not activate in this PR. Separate clinical decision about usefulness and known serum incompatibility needed before filling childhood gap; prefer more recent sensitive assay data if available.
